scope: Literal evidence correspondence for exact duplication claims only; no semantic gate or source change

items.actualErrorCorrection: Materializing all rows transfers detail that the screen never displays. If operators could inspect individual reservations inline, a bounded detail load for the selected station would be warranted.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If operators could inspect individual reservations inline, a bounded detail load for the selected station would be warranted.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Taking a page after loading everything defeats the stated bound. If the list omitted gardener names, the plot page could be returned without loading gardeners.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the list omitted gardener names, the plot page could be returned without loading gardeners.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Loading every child increases transfer and memory for values the query can aggregate. If the report later needs individual annotation text, it should use a separate detail query.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the report later needs individual annotation text, it should use a separate detail query.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Deferred access can attempt I/O after the bounded read scope is gone. If the upload were performed inside a streaming database scope by design, resource lifetime would need an explicit separate decision.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the upload were performed inside a streaming database scope by design, resource lifetime would need an explicit separate decision.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Deferred loads add hidden reads for fields guaranteed to be shown. If the grant set were unbounded or only a subset were displayed, a separate paged query could be preferable.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the grant set were unbounded or only a subset were displayed, a separate paged query could be preferable.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Eager loading transfers large optional notes for every aircraft. If replacement date must be derived from note history, the query should state that bounded aggregate explicitly.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If replacement date must be derived from note history, the query should state that bounded aggregate explicitly.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The broad load carries data outside the stated display contract. If capacity were not persisted and had to be calculated from active referrals, a controlled aggregate query would be needed.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If capacity were not persisted and had to be calculated from active referrals, a controlled aggregate query would be needed.

items.actualErrorCorrection: One hidden lookup per row scales query count with the rendered list. If each row also showed full owner history, that relationship would need its own explicit bounded access plan.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If each row also showed full owner history, that relationship would need its own explicit bounded access plan.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Repeated per-assignment reads make query count grow with the page. If only selected volunteers’ skills were shown, an explicit detail read after selection would be smaller.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If only selected volunteers’ skills were shown, an explicit detail read after selection would be smaller.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The logs are large and not read on the list screen. If the list needed a small log status, project that status rather than the complete log.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the list needed a small log status, project that status rather than the complete log.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Deferred reads can occur outside the stated data scope. If photo count were unbounded, the workflow would need a bounded evidence page rather than an unrestricted eager load.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If photo count were unbounded, the workflow would need a bounded evidence page rather than an unrestricted eager load.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Eagerly loading bodies and attachments carries unneeded data. If a search snippet were required, project only that bounded snippet.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If a search snippet were required, project only that bounded snippet.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Collection-wide history is unrelated to a single asset edit. If an edit action depended on a specific historical rendition, that revision should be loaded explicitly before the action.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If an edit action depended on a specific historical rendition, that revision should be loaded explicitly before the action.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Per-grant loads repeat access for each displayed permission. If the grant count were unbounded, paginate the grant view instead of loading all rows.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the grant count were unbounded, paginate the grant view instead of loading all rows.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Fetching all components increases list work for results never opened. If the search displayed component names, project those names or load a bounded summary for the result page.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the search displayed component names, project those names or load a bounded summary for the result page.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Large payloads are not needed for metadata search. If the search needed a digest, project the digest field rather than loading the binary content.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the search needed a digest, project the digest field rather than loading the binary content.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The dashboard need not transfer all underlying records. If the total were calculated from a domain rule not expressible as an aggregate, use an explicitly scoped domain query.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the total were calculated from a domain rule not expressible as an aggregate, use an explicitly scoped domain query.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The entire history is not consumed by this operation. If the balance must be recomputed from all allocations, that becomes an explicit aggregate requirement rather than an implicit graph load.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the balance must be recomputed from all allocations, that becomes an explicit aggregate requirement rather than an implicit graph load.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The changed amount is a different command payload, so the existing operation ID cannot be reused for it. If the caller retried with the original amount, the service could return the result already stored for that command.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: An identical retry can resolve the original result; a changed payload under the same identity must be rejected.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Retrying unchanged invalid input cannot repair its validation failure. If validation occurred after a possible write, the result would need reconciliation rather than this pre-write response.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If validation occurred after a possible write, the result would need reconciliation rather than this pre-write response.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Blind rebase can overwrite geometry the second editor never saw. If the product defined a merge rule for concurrent edits, it could offer a merge after detecting the version mismatch.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the product defined a merge rule for concurrent edits, it could offer a merge after detecting the version mismatch.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Publishing first can notify users about a notice that never commits. The design provides durable retryable intent and duplicate tolerance, not universal exactly-once delivery.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: The design provides durable retryable intent and duplicate tolerance, not universal exactly-once delivery.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Both processes can pass their own check before either save completes. The implementation could use a database constraint or a transactionally checked write; the case does not prescribe one technology.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: The implementation could use a database constraint or a transactionally checked write; the case does not prescribe one technology.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Sending is not the same as remote acceptance. If the remote API offered a definitive rejection response, the local state could transition directly to rejected.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the remote API offered a definitive rejection response, the local state could transition directly to rejected.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The case states one transaction may exceed its operational limit. If the batch contract required all assets to appear atomically, partial checkpoints would not satisfy it.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the batch contract required all assets to appear atomically, partial checkpoints would not satisfy it.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Discarding the original link loses the delivery promise and confirmed work. If neither vendor response were known, both portions would remain unresolved rather than confirmed.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If neither vendor response were known, both portions would remain unresolved rather than confirmed.

items.actualErrorCorrection: A title can be reused across separate experiments. If the caller used a new run ID, it would represent a new experiment under the stated contract.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the caller used a new run ID, it would represent a new experiment under the stated contract.

items.actualErrorCorrection: One principal ID would suppress valid later events. If the provider assigned a new event ID to a genuine correction, that correction should be processed as its own event.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the provider assigned a new event ID to a genuine correction, that correction should be processed as its own event.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Volunteer identity does not distinguish two claims for the same reminder. If a lease could never be reassigned while work was active, the stale completion race would not arise.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If a lease could never be reassigned while work was active, the stale completion race would not arise.

items.actualErrorCorrection: A crash between writes leaves the ledger inconsistent. If balance were derived solely from allocation rows, the stored balance update might not be needed.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If balance were derived solely from allocation rows, the stored balance update might not be needed.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Creating pending work contradicts the stated no-write cancellation. If cancellation occurred after submission with unknown commit status, the system would need to reconcile the attempt instead.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If cancellation occurred after submission with unknown commit status, the system would need to reconcile the attempt instead.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Current inputs can produce a different amount from the original decision. If the product intentionally recalculated live payouts on every view, historical reproduction would not be required.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the product intentionally recalculated live payouts on every view, historical reproduction would not be required.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Price can become visible before stock validation. If price and stock were independent listing attributes under the product contract, separate writes could be acceptable.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If price and stock were independent listing attributes under the product contract, separate writes could be acceptable.

items.actualErrorCorrection: Titles can collide and do not identify the provider asset. If the provider key could be reused for different assets, the import would need a broader identity scope.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the provider key could be reused for different assets, the import would need a broader identity scope.

items.actualErrorCorrection: The timeout leaves delivery unresolved. The stated status feed can answer by the request reference, but the case does not authorize repeating the send while that status is unknown.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: If the provider returned a definitive rejection, the local delivery could be marked rejected instead of remaining unresolved.

items.actualErrorCorrection: New command IDs obscure that both requests represent the same cancellation. A new cancellation with a different command ID would need its own validation against current reservation state.
items.actualBoundaryOrTradeoff: A new cancellation with a different command ID would need its own validation against current reservation state.
